text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Von Willebrand Disease. The clinical presentation of frequent epistaxis, gum bleeding, petechiae, and bruising in a young child is highly suggestive of a coagulation factor deficiency, specifically Von Willebrand Disease, given the mucosal bleeding pattern.
